title: Structural identifiability of the inherited Wilson endpoint readouts
selected_from: AI in Round26 roadmap, after five expert recommendations and independent skeptic triage
model: Canonical summable full-link SU(2) family of AD1/AD2, and explicitly labeled asymptotic readout maps derived from it

parameters.q: dimensionless summability parameter in (0,1), not lattice spacing
parameters.E_star: fixed positive reference energy; comparisons must retain alpha/E_star

requirements: Derive the parameter combinations identified by complete limiting demodulated Wilson readout curves; compare physical-time and scaled-time conventions explicitly.
Construct exact distinct-parameter fibers or prove injectivity in the declared parameter domain; demonstrate with rational arithmetic where possible.
Distinguish the endpoint map from the actual finite-q model; do not infer exact finite-q nonidentifiability from an asymptotic equality.
Analyze the extra information in undemodulated readouts and the demodulation/calibration assumptions; retain aliasing and sign/domain restrictions.
Propose a genuinely discriminating additional readout and list its physical/model/calibration obligations without declaring them experimentally fulfilled.
Run explicit wrong-inference controls including elementary null slow probe and parameter compensation; separate analytic proof from numerical illustrations.
acceptance: Separate authored derivations and executable checks; skeptical review may accept a scoped obstruction/conditional identification while parent AI remains limited. No continuum or homogeneous model transfer.
execution: Newton forward and Feynman reverse derive without reading each other current ai1 files until both frozen; advisor integrates after skeptic review.
